title: Quantum Foundations in Lean: Finite-Dimensional Formalizations and Typed Premise Audits
description: A Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of finite-dimensional quantum foundations. This release adds a machine-checked finite refinement-consistency route generated by elementary binary splits, upgrades elementary split consistency to finite refinement consistency, connects this route to Born calibration, and includes relative sharpness witnesses showing the independent role of normalization, projective null support, refinement consistency, and positivity. This record archives GitHub tag v1.4.0-journal-audit. Its direct Gleason dependency remains pinned to tag v1.1.0-journal-audit at commit 5c5bc40d2e4a31a0d1b3112fcc9a3e92b2000ec5.
